doc.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Growing up in Cowdenbeath, Fife
summary: His home town in Fife, a Scottish county called a Kingdom, which he left at 17 or 18.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well growing up in Scotland, right, your home town was what?
I wasn’t going to try to pronounce that.

Cowdenbealth is about maybe 20 miles northeast of Edinburgh. It’s in Fife actually. It’s over the other side of the Forth Bridge. And it’s in the Kingdom of Fife. And that’s the only County in Scotland that’s actually called a Kingdom. So I grew up there, but I left there when I was like 17 or 18, 17 maybe.
